A1.justification: Local reading commands, including extraction of both PDFs and reading the PDF skill, stalled without returning content. Although both files are identified as versions of the same work, their essential material and appendices could not be inspected. This is an evidence-access gap, not evidence of deleted content.

before.justification: No content was obtained from v3.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be established.

after.justification: No content was obtained from v4.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be established.

M1.justification: The methods could not be inspected or matched, preventing assessment of algorithm or model changes.

E1.justification: Dataset, task, and test-scenario coverage could not be read in either version.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were unavailable, so comparator membership could not be verified.

E3.justification: Evaluation protocols and experimental settings could not be inspected for differences.

E4.justification: Neither the main text nor appendices could be inspected for changes to ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and uncertainty-reporting practices could not be compared.

E6.justification: No result passages, tables, or figures were obtained, preventing verification of numerical or qualitative changes.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected in either version.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were unavailable for comparing core claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be compared.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures could not be inspected.

R1.justification: Citations and research-positioning passages could not be read or matched.

P1.justification: The document text and section structures were unavailable, preventing assessment of rewriting or reorganization.

P2.justification: The PDF pages could not be visually inspected, preventing assessment of figures, tables, and layout.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF could be inspected because local reading tools returned no document content. Consequently, there is insufficient evidence to assess benefits, harms, or the overall quality difference.
